critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_build_assistant_context correctly scopes all CRM data (appointments, calls, callbacks, contracts, contacts) to user_id — multi-tenant isolation verified.
AssistantChat.tsx multi-turn history is rebuilt server-side each request by prepending last 12 DB rows to the user prompt — reliable and stateless-friendly.
AssistantFAB is properly gated on `if (!user) return null` (line 428) so FAB never leaks on login screen — verified.
Message chronological order enforced via .sort('created_at', 1) in /assistant/history and reversed history in /assistant/chat — good.
Reset endpoint only issues a new session_id (no DB write) — messages persist under old session for auditability; new session is materialized on first chat POST.
